name: heterogeneous_routed_final_protocol_v2
interpretation: Validation of a negative/benchmark finding. The routed method is not presumed to beat public-anchor-only.

model_configuration.client_target_source_partition: three disjoint balanced 256-example AG News client pools

evaluation.split: full official AG News test set
evaluation.analysis: paired seed differences, 95% confidence intervals; report all seeds even if candidate loses

predeclared_interpretation.candidate_beats_anchor_only: Investigate statistical support but do not claim beyond tested scope.
predeclared_interpretation.candidate_does_not_beat_anchor_only: Frame the paper as a benchmark/diagnostic study: local routing reduces harm but public anchors remain the strongest server objective under this controlled setting.
